# New Zealand Loyal website (nzloyal.com) — policies

> Archive note: NZ Loyal's registered website, nzloyal.com, returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot challenge) to curl and to headless Chromium on 2026-10-23; newzealandloyal.com only redirects to a parking 'lander' page; web.archive.org is unreachable from this environment. The party's own policy pages could therefore NOT be captured. The only verbatim party wording available is the list RNZ quoted from the party website (12 Oct 2026), reproduced below exactly as RNZ printed it.

## Full text

**Not retrievable.** The full text could not be captured; see the archive note above. Nothing in this file is a paraphrase of the original.

# NZ Loyal's policies as quoted from its website by RNZ

> Archive note: Secondary source: RNZ's verbatim quotation of the party's website. This is not the party's full policy text, which could not be retrieved.

## Full text (verbatim)

### As quoted by RNZ ("Explainer: What you need to know about the smaller political parties in this year's election", 12 October 2026)

New Zealand Loyal What they say about themselves : "We reject government overrreach. We take our country back from foreign interests. We restore our freedoms. No compromise. No apologies." What their policies include: "End our participation in the UN, WEF, WHO; End climate accords based on faulty science; Establish energy independence, including oil and gas; Save our farmers from restrictive regulations; Scrap the current tax system; Scrap all race-based policies; Establish a NZ Constitution; Expose and eradicate propaganda from our news media; Protect our children from corrupt sex and gender 'education'; Decentralise government and return power to the people."
